mapper.sql: d.doc_id, d.doc_no, d.doc_type, d.doc_nm, d.use_yn, d.remark, d.row_ver, d.updated_at, rr.doc_rev_id as released_rev_id, rr.rev as released_rev, rr.released_at, orv.doc_rev_id as open_rev_id, orv.rev as open_rev, orv.status as open_status, (select string_agg(coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd, p.proc_cd), ', ' order by t.target_id) from mst_doc_target t left join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = t.item_class_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = t.proc_id where t.doc_id = d.doc_id) as target_text, (select count(*) from mst_doc_target t where t.doc_id = d.doc_id) as target_cnt
from mst_doc d left join mst_doc_rev rr on rr.doc_id = d.doc_id and rr.status = 'RELEASED' left join mst_doc_rev orv on orv.doc_id = d.doc_id and orv.status in ('DRAFT', 'IN_APPROVAL')

where.if: and (d.doc_no ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or d.doc_nm ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\')

select where d.doc_id = #{id}
select doc_id from mst_doc where doc_id = #{id} for update

select class_id as id, use_yn from mst_item_class where class_cd = #{cd}
select proc_id as id, use_yn from mst_proc where proc_cd = #{cd}

mapper.sql: r.doc_rev_id, r.doc_id, d.doc_no, d.doc_type, d.doc_nm, r.rev, r.status, r.change_summary, r.source_rev_id, r.apr_id, a.status as apr_status, a.requester_id as apr_requester_id, r.submitted_at, r.submitted_by, r.released_at, r.released_by, r.obsoleted_at, r.obsoleted_by, r.row_ver, (select count(*) from sys_file f where f.target_type = 'qms-doc' and f.target_id = r.doc_rev_id::text and f.use_yn = 'Y') as file_cnt
mapper.select: select from mst_doc_rev r join mst_doc d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = r.apr_id where r.doc_id = #{docId} order by r.doc_rev_id desc
select status from mst_doc_rev where doc_rev_id = #{id} for update
select status from mst_doc_rev where doc_rev_id = #{id}
select rev from mst_doc_rev where doc_id = #{docId}

insert into mst_doc_rev (comp_cd, doc_id, rev, source_rev_id, change_summary, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{docId}, #{rev}, #{sourceRevId}, #{summary}, #{by}, #{by}) returning doc_rev_id
mapper.update: update mst_doc_rev set rev = #{rev}, change_summary = #{summary}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where doc_rev_id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
update mst_doc_rev set status = 'DRAFT', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where doc_rev_id = #{id} and status = 'IN_APPROVAL'

update sys_file set locked_yn = 'Y', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where target_type = 'qms-doc' and target_id = cast(#{id} as varchar) and use_yn = 'Y' and locked_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select l.seq, l.approver_id, u.user_nm as approver_nm, l.line_type, l.status, l.acted_at, l.comment from apr_line l join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.approver_id where l.apr_id = #{aprId} order by l.seq
mapper.sql: p.status = 'RELEASED' and p.valid_from <= #{today} and (p.valid_to is null or p.valid_to > #{today})
mapper.select: select 'SPECIAL_NOT_IN_PLAN' as check_cd, ch.char_id as ref_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, pr.proc_cd) || '-' || ch.char_no as target_cd, ch.char_nm as target_nm, ch.special_cls as detail from qms_char ch left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = ch.proc_id where ch.use_yn = 'Y' and ch.special_cls <> 'NONE' and (i.item_id is null or i.use_yn = 'Y') and (pr.proc_id is null or pr.use_yn = 'Y') and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_insp_plan p on p.insp_plan_id = l.insp_plan_id where l.char_id = ch.char_id and ) order by 3 limit #{limit}

select 'PLAN_NO_INSP_STD' as check_cd, p.insp_plan_id as ref_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(i.item_nm, c.class_nm) as target_nm, p.insp_type || ' / ' || p.rev || coalesce(' / ' || pr.proc_cd, '') as detail from qms_insp_plan p left join mst_item i on i.item_id = p.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = p.item_class_id left join mst_proc pr on pr.proc_id = p.proc_id where and not exists (select 1 from mst_doc_rev r where r.doc_rev_id = p.doc_rev_id and r.status = 'RELEASED') and not exists (select 1 from mst_doc d join mst_doc_rev r on r.doc_id = d.doc_id and r.status = 'RELEASED' join mst_doc_target t on t.doc_id = d.doc_id where d.doc_type = 'INSP_STD' and d.use_yn = 'Y' and (t.item_id = p.item_id or t.item_class_id = coalesce(p.item_class_id, i.item_class_id) or (p.proc_id is not null and t.proc_id = p.proc_id))) order by 3, p.insp_type limit #{limit}

select 'PLAN_DOC_OBSOLETE' as check_cd, p.insp_plan_id as ref_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, c.class_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(i.item_nm, c.class_nm) as target_nm, p.insp_type || ' / ' || p.rev || ' → ' || d.doc_no || ' / ' || r.rev as detail from qms_insp_plan p join mst_doc_rev r on r.doc_rev_id = p.doc_rev_id and r.status = 'OBSOLETE' join mst_doc d on d.doc_id = r.doc_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = p.item_id left join mst_item_class c on c.class_id = p.item_class_id where () or p.status = 'DRAFT' order by 3, p.insp_type limit #{limit}
select 1 from (select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('mst_doc_rev.source_key:' || #{key}))) x
